web-guide-idea-19.audience: Home cooks and people who miss familiar regional meals.
web-guide-idea-19.offer: Host a real cooking session with the family tips that make the dish yours. Viewers pay for live explanation and the opportunity to ask about texture or timing.
web-guide-idea-19.steps.0: Choose a manageable menu and prepare ingredients.
web-guide-idea-19.steps.1: Cook with the camera showing key stages clearly.
web-guide-idea-19.steps.2: Explain substitutions and answer questions before serving.
web-guide-idea-19.equipment: A phone, stand, Wi-Fi and normal kitchen equipment. Keep the camera away from steam and heat.
web-guide-idea-19.returnReason: Build a regional menu series with seasonal recipes and everyday family stories.
web-guide-idea-19.promotion: Share the dish and ingredient list early so interested viewers can cook alongside if they choose.

web-guide-idea-19.metadataDescription: Prepare a regional meal from your kitchen, sharing family tips and answering cooking questions. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
